SELECT p.* FROM proj_project_tree_path t JOIN proj_project p ON p.id = t.descendant_project_id AND p.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND p.deleted = b'0' WHERE t.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND t.deleted = b'0' AND t.root_project_id = #{query.rootProjectId} AND t.tree_version = #{query.treeVersion} AND t.distance = 0
AND p.id IN #{id}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY p.tree_depth, p.tree_sort, p.id
